arxiv-2103-13215.creator: Igor Vinograd, Rui Zhou, Michihiro Hirata, Tao Wu, Hadrien Mayaffre, Steffen Krämer, Ruixing Liang, W.N. Hardy, D.A. Bonn, Marc-Henri Julien

Bonn, Marc-Henri Julien. In order to identify the mechanism responsible for the formation of charge-density waves (CDW) in cuprate superconductors, it is important to understand which aspects of the CDW’s microscopic structure are generic and which are material-dependent.

arxiv-2105-03274.title: Lovász-Type Theorems and Game Comonads Thanks: Research supported in part by the EPSRC grant EP/T007257/1, and by the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 837724. To appear in the Proceedings of the 36th Annual ACM/IEEE S
arxiv-2105-03274.creator: Anuj Dawar and Tomáš Jakl, Luca Reggio
arxiv-2105-03274.description: Abstract . Lovász (1967) showed that two finite relational structures A A and B B are isomorphic if, and only if, the number of homomorphisms from C C to A A is the same as the number of homomorphisms from C C to B B for any finite structure C C .

arxiv-2111-13867.title: Why Mercury is a Superconductor
arxiv-2111-13867.creator: Cesare Tresca, Gianni Profeta, Giovanni Marini, Giovanni B. Bachelet, Antonio Sanna, Matteo Calandra, Lilia Boeri
arxiv-2111-13867.description: Abstract Despite being the oldest known superconductor, solid mercury is mysteriously absent from all current computational databases of superconductors. In this work, we present a critical study of its superconducting properties based on state-of-the-art superconducting density-functional theory. Our calculations reveal numerous anomalies in electronic and lattice properties, which can mostly be handled, with due care, by modern ab-initio techniques.

arxiv-2205-03152.title: BIP! Scholar : A Service to Facilitate Fair Researcher Assessment
arxiv-2205-03152.creator: Thanasis Vergoulis, Serafeim Chatzopoulos, Kleanthis Vichos, Ilias Kanellos, Andrea Mannocci, Natalia Manola, Paolo Manghi
arxiv-2205-03152.description: Abstract . In recent years, assessing the performance of researchers has become a burden due to the extensive volume of the existing research output. As a result, evaluators often end up relying heavily on a selection of performance indicators like the h-index.

arxiv-2209-14905.title: Variance-Covariance Regularization Enforces Pairwise Independence in Self-Supervised Representations
arxiv-2209-14905.creator: Grégoire Mialon, Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun
arxiv-2209-14905.description: Abstract Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) methods such as VICReg, Barlow Twins or W-MSE avoid collapse of their joint embedding architectures by constraining or regularizing the covariance matrix of their projector’s output. This study highlights important properties of such strategy, which we coin Variance-Covariance regularization (VCReg).

arxiv-2301-11118.title: Dual Box Embeddings for the Description Logic ℰ ​ ℒ + ⁣ + \mathcal{EL^{++}} Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2024; May 13–17, 2024; Singapore, Singapore Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2024 (WWW ’24), May 13–17, 2024, Singapore, Singapore DOI: 10.1145/3589334.3645648 ISBN: 979
arxiv-2301-11118.creator: Mathias Jackermeier, Jiaoyan Chen, Ian Horrocks
arxiv-2301-11118.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mathias Jackermeier, Jiaoyan Chen, Ian Horrocks. OWL ontologies, whose formal semantics are rooted in Description Logic (DL), have been widely used for knowledge representation. Similar to Knowledge Graphs (KGs), ontologies are often incomplete, and maintaining and constructing them has proved challenging. While classical deductive reasoning algorithms use the precise formal semantics of an ontology to predict missing facts, recent years have witnessed growing interest in inductive reasoning techniques that can derive probable facts from an ontology.

arxiv-2305-05331.title: Explainable Recommender with Geometric Information Bottleneck
arxiv-2305-05331.creator: Hanqi Yan, Lin Gui, Menghan Wang, Kun Zhang, Yulan He
arxiv-2305-05331.description: Abstract Explainable recommender systems can explain their recommendation decisions, enhancing user trust in the systems. Most explainable recommender systems either rely on human-annotated rationales to train models for explanation generation or leverage the attention mechanism to extract important text spans from reviews as explanations.

arxiv-2307-04499.title: First order synthesis for data words revisited
arxiv-2307-04499.creator: Julien Grange, Mathieu Lehaut
arxiv-2307-04499.description: Abstract We carry on the study of the synthesis problem on data words for fragments of first order logic, and delineate precisely the border between decidability and undecidability. 1 Introduction The reactive synthesis problem, which dates back to Church [ 4 ] , is about generating a correct-by-construction program with respect to a given specification.

arxiv-2309-03799.title: FisheyePP4AV: A privacy-preserving method for autonomous vehicles on fisheye camera images † Equally contributed. ✉ Corresponding author.
arxiv-2309-03799.creator: Linh Trinh † ✉, Bach Ha †, Anh Tu Tran
arxiv-2309-03799.description: Abstract In many parts of the world, the use of vast amounts of data collected on public roadways for autonomous driving has increased. In order to detect and anonymize pedestrian faces and nearby car license plates in actual road-driving scenarios, there is an urgent need for effective solutions.

arxiv-2407-19003.title: Holographic dual of defect CFT with corner contributions
arxiv-2407-19003.creator: Xinyu Sun, Shao-Kai Jian
arxiv-2407-19003.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xinyu Sun, Shao-Kai Jian. We study defect CFT within the framework of holographic duality, emphasizing the impact of corner contributions. We model distinct conformal defects using interface branes that differ in tensions and are connected by a corner. Employing the relationship between CFT scaling dimensions and Euclidean gravity actions, we outline a general procedure for calculating the anomalous dimensions of defect changing operators at nontrivial cusps. Several analytical results are obtained, including the cusp anomalous dimensions at big and small angles.

arxiv-2408-12658.title: Hierarchical Generative Modeling of Melodic Vocal Contours in Hindustani Classical Music
arxiv-2408-12658.description: Abstract Hindustani music is a performance-driven oral tradition that exhibits the rendition of rich melodic patterns. In this paper, we focus on generative modeling of singers’ vocal melodies extracted from audio recordings, as the voice is musically prominent within the tradition.

arxiv-2409-17191.title: An Effective, Robust and Fairness-aware Hate Speech Detection Framework PubID: pubid: 978-1-6654-3902-2/21/$31.00 ©2021 IEEE
arxiv-2409-17191.creator: Guanyi Mou, Kyumin Lee
arxiv-2409-17191.description: Abstract With the widespread online social networks, hate speeches are spreading faster and causing more damage than ever before. Existing hate speech detection methods have limitations in several aspects, such as handling data insufficiency, estimating model uncertainty, improving robustness against malicious attacks, and handling unintended bias (i.e., fairness).

arxiv-2504-06214.title: From 128K to 4M: Efficient Training of Ultra-Long Context Large Language Models
arxiv-2504-06214.creator: Chejian Xu, Wei Ping, Peng Xu, Zihan Liu, Boxin Wang, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bo Li, Bryan Catanzaro
arxiv-2504-06214.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chejian Xu, Wei Ping, Peng Xu, Zihan Liu, Boxin Wang, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bo Li, Bryan Catanzaro. Long-context capabilities are essential for a wide range of applications, including document and video understanding, in-context learning, and inference-time scaling, all of which require models to process and reason over long sequences of text and multimodal data.

arxiv-2507-05854.title: Addressing the Hubble Tension: Insights from Reversible and Irreversible Thermodynamic Processes
arxiv-2507-05854.creator: Hussain Gohar
arxiv-2507-05854.description: Abstract We investigate the role of reversible and irreversible thermodynamic processes in a cosmological context, focusing on their impact on the early and late-time expansion history of the universe. In our framework, gravitationally induced adiabatic matter creation/annihilation are treated as irreversible processes, while energy exchange between the cosmic bulk and the horizon is modeled as reversible.

arxiv-2510-11950.title: Digital Low-Level RF system for the Linac Electronics Modernization Plan at LCLS
arxiv-2510-11950.creator: N. Sawai, J. Diaz Cruz, A. Benwell, S. Hoobler, Q. Du, S. Murthy, L. Doolittle
arxiv-2510-11950.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by N. Sawai, J. Diaz Cruz, A. Benwell, S. Hoobler, Q. Du, S. Murthy, L. Doolittle. The LCLS began operations in 2009, utilizing SLAC’s normal-conducting (NC) LINAC, which features control equipment dating back to the 1960s and 1980s. The Linac Electronics Modernization Plan (LEMP) aims to replace the legacy control equipment with a system based on the open-source Marble carrier board and Zest+ digitizer board, both of which are used in the LCLS-II HE LLRF system.

arxiv-2511-17207.title: SING3R-SLAM: Submap-based Indoor Monocular Gaussian SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
arxiv-2511-17207.creator: Kunyi Li, Michael Niemeyer, Sen Wang, Stefano Gasperini, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari
arxiv-2511-17207.description: Abstract Recent advances in dense 3D reconstruction enable the accurate capture of local geometry; however, integrating them into SLAM is challenging due to drift and redundant point maps, which limit efficiency and downstream tasks, such as novel view synthesis. To address these issues, we propose SING3R-SLAM, a globally consistent and compact Gaussian-based dense RGB SLAM framework.

pmc-11619744.title: Developing a large‐scale quality improvement program for thyroid cancer surgery
pmc-11619744.creator: Catherine B. Jensen, Elizabeth M. Bacon, Lauren N. Krumeich, Hunter J. Underwood, David T. Hughes, Paul G. Gauger, Richard Burney, Susan C. Pitt
pmc-11619744.description: BackgroundSurgical quality improvement (QI) plays a critical role in optimizing patient outcomes and reducing healthcare costs. QI programs focusing specifically on thyroid cancer surgical care are lacking. This study aimed to (a) select and introduce surgical quality indicators for thyroid cancer and (b) identify areas for QI at the state‐level.

pmc-11671489.title: Study on regional differences and causes of emergency logistics responsiveness under the impact of public emergencies—findings from Chinese samples
pmc-11671489.creator: Heng Chen, Yuan Guo, Xianglong Lin, Xianchao Qi
pmc-11671489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionIn recent years, the frequency and intensity of natural disasters and public emergencies around the world have been steadily increasing. Emergency logistics plays an irreplaceable role in providing rapid material and service support in the aftermath of disasters.

pmc-11692796.title: A META-ANALYSIS OF EXTRACELLULAR VESICLES BIOMARKERS IN THE DIAGNOSIS OF ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE AND RELATED DEMENTIAS
pmc-11692796.creator: Hash Brown Taha
pmc-11692796.description: Accurate differential diagnosis of dementia disorders including Alzheimer’s disease (AD), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB), Parkinson’s disease dementia (PDD), and vascular cognitive impairment and dementia (VCID), along with conditions like prodromal mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or negative controls (NCs), continues to challenge neurologists.

pmc-12471628.title: Retrospective Analysis of Therapeutic Modalities in Prosthetic Heart Valve Thrombosis: A 15-Year Single-Center Experience
pmc-12471628.creator: Alper Uzunselvi, Serkan Yüksel, Muhammet Uyanik, Ignatios Ikonomidis, Stefano De Servi
pmc-12471628.description: Background and Objectives: Prosthetic valve thrombosis (PVT) represents a rare but critical complication after heart valve replacement surgery. This study aimed to evaluate patient characteristics, treatment modalities (medical vs. surgical), and clinical outcomes in patients with PVT over a 15-year period, with a particular focus on the impact of New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class on mortality.

pmc-12622514.title: Direct Nucleation of Hierarchical Nanostructures on Plasmonic Fiber Optics Enables Enhanced SERS Performance
pmc-12622514.creator: Di Zheng, Riccardo Scarfiello, Muhammad Fayyaz Kashif, Liam Collard, Linda Piscopo, Maria Samuela Andriani, Elisabetta Perrone, Concetta Nobile, Massimo De Vittorio, Ferruccio Pisanello, Luigi Carbone
pmc-12622514.description: An innovative fabrication method is presented to achieve bottom‐up in situ surface‐overstructured Au nanoislands (NIs) with tunable grades of surface coverage, elongation, and branching, directly on micro‐optical fibers for sensing applications. These all‐in‐gold hierarchical nanostructures consist of NIs coated with surface protrusions of various morphologies.

pmc-12873424.title: ScRNA profiling of peripheral blood in kidney transplant recipients across rejection responses and treatments
pmc-12873424.creator: Dan Wu, Jia You, Hongxia Liu, Kaile Zheng, Yan Zhu, Na Zeng, Hong Sun, Xuebin Wang
pmc-12873424.description: Studies have reported diverse functions of immune cells in response against the transplanted kidney, highlighting their significant roles in immunosuppressive response. Peripheral blood analyses showed differences in immune cell composition between kidney transplant recipients and healthy donors, however, the differences in peripheral blood immune landscape between patients with different rejection types and treatment phases remain unclear.

pmc-13087435.title: Direct Oral Anticoagulants Versus Low‐Molecular‐Weight Heparin for Treating Venous Thromboembolism in Patients With Gastrointestinal Cancer
pmc-13087435.creator: Wei‐Ting Chang, Mei‐Chuan Lee, Hui‐Wen Lin, Sheng‐Hsiang Lin, Yi‐Heng Li
pmc-13087435.description: BackgroundDirect oral anticoagulants (DOACs) have demonstrated non‐inferiority to low‐molecular‐weight heparin (LMWH) for preventing recurrent venous thromboembolism (VTE) in cancer‐associated thrombosis. However, patients with gastrointestinal (GI) cancer receiving DOACs have reported increased major bleeding events. Hereby, we aim to compare the risks of recurrent thromboembolism and bleeding between those treated with DOACs and LMWH.

pmc-13427547.title: Accurately modeling RNase H-mediated antisense oligonucleotide efficacy
pmc-13427547.creator: Barney Hill, Maisie R. Jaques, Remya R. Nair, Nicola Whiffin, Matthew J.A. Wood, Stephan J. Sanders, Peter L. Oliver, Alyssa C. Hill, Carlo Rinaldi
pmc-13427547.description: Antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) are a powerful class of drugs with the potential to treat a wide range of human diseases. However, the prediction of ASO efficacy remains challenging, as large-scale and costly experimental screens are typically required to identify optimal candidates for a specific therapeutic target.
